title: Brain entry front matter
description: The YAML front matter of one entry in the team's shared memory. The body below it is free markdown.

id.description: Stable identifier; the file name without .md. Links name it.

kind.description: decision=why a choice was made | research=notes, sources and comparisons | concept=a term or how something works | entity=a person, stakeholder, service, resource or sponsor | lesson=what a session learned | procedure=how to do something, entered only with an approver's recorded approval (approved_by, approved_on) | note=meeting or demo notes.

author.description: The handle of the developer who wrote it: a key in systems.yaml owners.

created.description: The day the entry was written.

status.description: active=current | draft=not yet settled | superseded=kept for history; a newer entry links to it.

tags.description: Free lower-case labels used to filter.

links.description: Ids of related entries; every one must exist.

sources.description: Where the content comes from: URLs, documents, idea ids, file paths.

approved_by.description: For a procedure: the handle of the developer who approved it; systems.yaml must list them as approving procedures.

approved_on.description: For a procedure: the day it was approved.
